efficacy.quote: At week 4, least-squares mean ± SE reduction in IOP from baseline with OMDI (-5.93 ± 0.23 mm Hg) was noninferior to that of latanoprost (-6.56 ± 0.22 mm Hg; 95% confidence interval between groups: 0.01-1.26).

Macular edema in pseudophakic eyes (RENGE, label 5.4) is not scored as a miss: the monkeys were phakic and could not show a pseudophakia-dependent harm. Nasal metaplasia has no measured human counterpart. A 2019 monkey study of omidenepag plus FP agonists (raised aqueous flare) is not scored: its human comparator (inflammation with tafluprost) has no admissible public source found.
